releases.name: Jesus Simulator
releases.summary: Jesus Simulator is a narrative driven game that retells the earthly life of Jesus Christ through the events of the Gospel. Become a witness to sermons, miracles, and encounters that explore love, mercy, faith, forgiveness, and sacrifice.

releases.name: John Fox
releases.summary:
John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor. But now his beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. 

You have to avenge him!

releases.name: Task Force Ranger - Breakpoint
releases.summary:
Task Force Ranger: Breakpoint is a modern military shooter focused on intense combat and high-risk special operations.

Deploy as Bravo Team in the conflict zone of Al-Shamal and carry out a series of dangerous missions against the Jazeera Front. Recover critical intelligence, destroy enemy infrastructure, eliminate hostile leadership, and cripple their ability to operate across the region.

Fight through fortified compounds, industrial facilities, urban districts, and remote mountain strongholds. Expect heavy resistance, armored threats, and large-scale firefights as enemy forces attempt to stop your advance.

Use assault rifles, machine guns, sniper rifles, pistols, explosives, and support weapons to complete your objectives and survive overwhelming odds.

Beyond the campaign, test your skills in Survival Mode, where endless enemy waves push your combat abilities to the limit. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and see how long you can hold the line.

releases.name: Kitties Solitaire
releases.summary:
340 levels of cozy, cuddly card fun.

Curl up with the coziest card game on your console! Kitties Solitaire wraps the classic TriPeaks Solitaire experience in an adorable world of playful cats, warm colors, and charming feline companions.
Clear the peaks one card at a time in this relaxing yet endlessly engaging solitaire adventure. With 340 handcrafted levels, every session brings a fresh challenge — and a new reason to keep those paws tapping.
Features:

Full TriPeaks Solitaire — Master the beloved card system that's easy to learn and satisfying to perfect.
340 Levels — A massive collection designed to keep you playing for hours on end.
Unique Card Layouts — Varied and creative board designs ensure no two levels feel the same, delivering long-term engagement.
Smooth & Responsive — Enjoy fluid animations and tight controls that make every move feel great.
Undo & Rewards — Rethink your strategy with the handy undo system, and collect rewards as you climb each peak.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or just love cute cats, Kitties Solitaire is the purr-fect way to unwind. Deal yourself in and let the good times paw-r in!

releases.name: Sandbox Doodle Playground
releases.summary:
Build. Craft. Destroy. Create Your Own Playground. Experiment Without Limits.

Sandbox Doodle Playground, a creative physics sandbox where your imagination becomes reality! Craft, build, experiment, and create endless scenarios using a huge collection of characters, weapons, vehicles, tools, and interactive objects.
Design your own worlds, build incredible machines, or unleash total chaos with realistic ragdoll physics. Every object reacts naturally, allowing you to create funny experiments, epic battles, crazy chain reactions, or peaceful constructions. There are no rules or missions—only unlimited freedom to play your way.
Whether you enjoy engineering complex contraptions, testing physics, or simply creating hilarious moments, Sandbox Doodle Playground gives you all the tools you need.

Features:
Creative physics sandbox with realistic interactions.
Draw and build your own unique playground.
Hundreds of objects, weapons, vehicles, and tools.
Realistic ragdoll physics and destructible environments.
Create machines, traps, battles, and chain reactions.
Endless possibilities with no limits or objectives.
Easy-to-use controls for players of all ages.

releases.name: Prison Escape Simulator 2026
releases.summary:
Can you dig a secret tunnel before the guards discover your plan?

Dig Your Way to Freedom

Trapped behind bars, you have only one chance to escape: dig a secret tunnel beneath your prison cell and reach freedom before the guards discover your plan.

Every day is a careful balancing act. Dig deeper into the ground, hide the tunnel entrance under your cell's carpet, and keep an eye on guard patrols. One mistake is all it takes to get caught, lose progress, and start over.

As you excavate the tunnel, you'll uncover valuable items buried underground. Trade them with the prison cook for soap—the prison's underground currency—and invest in powerful upgrades. Buy better tools to dig faster, increase your carrying capacity, and expand your pockets to secretly transport more dirt.

Managing the excavated soil is just as important as digging. Sneak outside and dispose of it before anyone becomes suspicious. The deeper your tunnel grows, the more careful you'll need to be.

releases.name: Grizzy & the Lemmings: Crazy Party
releases.summary: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Crazy Party is a family-focused party game for one to four players who can choose from 40 different lemming characters to play. The Lemmings compete across 50 zany mini-games, six game modes and five boards, inspired by the series, in a mad race to grab as much Yummy as possible right under Grizzy's nose - and he's not about to let them get away with it!

releases.name: Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek
releases.summary:
‘OBAKEIDORO 2: Chase & Seek’, is Japanese asymmetric multiplayer chase-and-seek game for up to 8 players. The game set this time is in old-Japan, with easy-to-understand rule of its predecessor, ‘OBAKEIDORO!’. 

The rule is simple. Each match lasts for only 3 minutes with simple control. The players play on either the Human team (3 players) or the Monster team (1 player). While the Human team must keep at least 1 Human out of jail to win, the Monster team must capture all Humans before the time runs out. They can, however, also strategize their thoughts using characters' skills and traits; these features allow everyone NOT to get bored!

releases.name: Aery - Surreal World
releases.summary:
Aery – Surreal World is a relaxing, story-driven flight exploration game that carries you through a series of impossible, dreamlike worlds where reality has quietly lost its mind. 

You play as a tiny spirit drifting endlessly forward through landscapes that shouldn't exist. Glide alongside an enormous dirty whale as it tumbles weightlessly through a sky laced with glittering rainbows — close enough to see the barnacles and grime clinging to its hide as streaks of violet and gold light wash over it. Descend into a sunken apartment block resting silently on the ocean floor, where coral has crept up the wallpaper, fish drift through the living room, and the television still flickers faintly in the deep blue dark. Soar through a vast kingdom where every tree, every cloud, and every cobblestone has been consumed by solid, gleaming gold — beautiful, eerie, and utterly silent. 

Each world is its own self-contained dream: a unique color palette, atmosphere, and mood that tells a different piece of a larger, quietly unfolding story. Hidden across every level are glowing memory fragments — scattered clues to what this broken universe once was. Collect enough of them and the next impossible world opens up.

Aery – Surreal World is designed above all else to feel good. The flying is smooth and freeing, the worlds are strange and beautiful, and the story unfolds gently without ever demanding anything of you. Whether you play to explore, to collect, or simply to get lost somewhere wonderfully weird, there is always something waiting just around the next impossible corner.

releases.name: Hololive Fantasy Battle
releases.summary:
【Breaking News】 Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle

■About This Game
Hololive Fantasy, the unit featuring 〈Houshou Marine〉〈Shirogane Noel〉〈Shiranui Flare〉 and 〈Usada Pekora〉, enters the biggest free-for-all battle of the century in pursuit of the wish-granting “Queen’s Throne”!
Experience “oshi victory” by winning with your oshi in this 2.5D versus action game for up to four players!
That's ‘Hololive Fantasy Battle’ #HoloBattle

■How to Play
・[Move] → [Attack] That’s it!
・Use unique attacks to stagger opponents, knock them back, and gain the upper hand!
・Obtaining a Red Super Weapon drastically changes your attacks!
・Launch the game-changing “Solo Live,” and let your oshi dominate the stage!

■Costume Change
・Your oshi is already cute enough, but now they’ll become even cuter. Can you darlings handle it?!

■Versus Mode: "Online Battle"
・Up to 4 players clash in an all-out brawl to decide the winner!
・Expand your strategy with combinations of [Each Talent's Unique Ability] × [Field Gimmicks]!

releases.name: Pool Party Boys: Splash Guys
releases.summary:
Sun's out, the pool's packed, and they're all rooting for you. Play the minigames, earn their attention and unlock exclusive images!

It's the hottest party of the summer and the guys are watching every move you make. Score big across the minigames and watch the gallery fill up with exclusive images of each character in his full pool party look.

Play hard, react fast, and hold your ground when things get intense. The boys notice everything, whether you're crushing it or just barely hanging on.

Some of them can't stop hyping you up. Others turn red every time you do something unexpected. All of them are worth getting to know better.

How deep into the gallery can you get before the sun goes down?


FEATURES:

● MINIGAMES WITH SPARK: Play through different challenges while they cheer, tease, and react to your every move.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Higher scores open up more images, more looks, more sides of each character.

● ANIME CHARACTERS WITH TONS OF PERSONALITY: From the one who never stops cheering to the one who can't hide his surprise, every reaction is part of the experience.

releases.name: Hex Park
releases.summary:
Welcome to Hex Park - a colorful playground of brainteasers where every move matters. Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, pop obstacles, and clear the board in as few moves as possible. It’s easy to pick up, delightfully tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

Tackle 150 handcrafted levels featuring smart mechanics: keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Plan routes, set up neat arrow alignments, and use handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill when you need a nudge. 

No timers, no stress - just clean, strategic puzzle-solving with that perfect “one more level” feel.

releases.name: Apocalypse ? No !
releases.summary: In Apocalypse ? No ! you play a survivor accompanied by his faithful dog in a world in ruins. Discover many varied maps: From a peaceful forest, through survivor camps to ruined cities, these maps are just waiting to be explored.

releases.name: Dark Witch Match!
releases.summary: The first-ever competitive puzzle game from the world of The Legend of Dark Witch! Match blocks, build chains, and overwhelm your rival in a Match-3 battler that's easy to learn but deep to master. Play cross-platform climb the global leaderboards, and dive into Story and Score Attack modes.

releases.name: Gods With Guns
releases.summary:
In Valhalla, heroes pull the trigger to defy Ragnarok! Rogue-like shooting game. 8 mythological heroes + 36 guns + 26 types of ammo + 60 Cards.

Become a Norse myth hero
Play as legendary characters like Odin, Thor, Loki, and Hela to fight against Ragnarok.

Enjoy fast-paced 2D gunplay
Experience smooth gun handling as you battle through storms of bullets and waves of enemies.

Build card combinations to enhance your power
Collect cards to strengthen your character and face endless enemies.

releases.name: Bloody Grids
releases.summary: A single move to carve a path through blood.Use the information on the grid to avoid, fight, and devour unseen enemies in this Minesweeper-style puzzle adventure.

releases.name: Combat School
releases.summary:
Before you save your country, you have to survive your sergeant.
Atten-hut! Welcome to the marines. My name's Sgt. J.T. Tail Kicker, and while you're here I'm gonna whip your scrawny hide into shape.
You hear me, boy? Wipe that silly smile off your face, this ain't no circus!
Before you leave, your lungs will burn on the obstacle course. Your fingers will cramp on the firing range. Your muscles will ache during chin ups and arm wrestling. Your stamina will suffer in the iron man race.
And if there's anything left of you, I'll give you a shot at me.
Can you take it, boy? You better. Cause terrorists have attacked our embassy, and America's depending on a real marine to save the day.
So suck in that gut. And have a pleasant stay at Boot Camp.
Featuring simultaneous play for two players or play against the computer.

releases.name: Talespinner
releases.summary: Enter a captivating realm woven with the tapestry of Japanese mythology in Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

releases.name: Loree 3D
releases.summary:
Waddle into adventure with Loree, a fearless penguin explorer! Race through colorful 3D worlds, dodge obstacles, and collect coins for family fun.

Join Loree, a brave and curious penguin, on a colorful 3D platforming adventure! Wearing his signature red propeller hat and cozy green scarf, Loree waddles, jumps, and glides his way through dozens of imaginative levels packed with challenges, secrets, and surprises.

releases.name: Montabi
releases.summary:
Tame, collect, fight! 

Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. 

Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

releases.name: Ink Splash
releases.summary:
Skateboard & Graffiti Action Game!

Ink Splash is a 2D action game.
Ride your skateboard and cover the ground with ink while creating graffiti on walls.
In Time Battle mode, the player with the higher score wins.
As you progress through stages, new tricks will be unlocked. Use a variety of moves to win graffiti battles.

releases.name: Mai: Child of Ages - Storms of Time
releases.summary:
The sudden appearance of a floating factory marks the beginning of a new chapter in the story of Mai: Child of Ages.

Explore brand-new dungeons set inside this colossal airborne structure, filled with ancient machinery, moving platforms, and forgotten experiments.


As Mai ventures deeper into its depths, she will uncover secrets tied to the factory’s origin and the mysterious machines that built it.


Face new enemies, overcome environmental hazards, and solve brand-new puzzles as you explore interconnected areas designed to challenge both your combat and platforming skills.


Main Features

· A new story chapter
· New dungeons set inside a massive floating factory and long-forgotten caverns
· Unique level design with vertical exploration
· New enemies, traps, and puzzles
· Lore that expands the game world
· New craftable items

The skies are no longer safe. What lies within the floating factory could change the course of time.

releases.name: Elthlead
releases.summary:
Become King Sieghart, lead the Forces of Light, and defeat Bozel and his Legions of Darkness! A masterpiece of fantasy strategy RPGs!

Originally released in 1988, this strategy RPG casts you as King Sieghart of Elthlead. Your mission is to defeat Bozel, the King of Velzeria, and restore peace to the continent of Gaia.

The game alternates between an Area Map for troop movement and a Tactical Map for unit-to-unit combat upon encountering the enemy. You must lead a diverse army—including Grandinos (Earth Dragons), Falcon Knights, Light Knights, Fighters, Archers, and White Dragons—to overcome the opposing forces.

While the core system is a straightforward battle for military supremacy, mastering tactical elements like terrain defense bonuses and area-of-effect magic is the true key to conquering the game.
